measures.name: Current AVG MAU YoY
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentTitle = SELECTEDVALUE(Franchise[TITLE_CODE])
VAR PriorTitle = LOOKUPVALUE(Franchise[PRIOR_TITLE_CODE], Franchise[TITLE_CODE], CurrentTitle)
VAR PriorPeriod = [PriorPeriod]
VAR PeriodType = [Selected Period Field Name]
VAR HasPriorTitle = NOT ISBLANK(PriorTitle)
VAR _MaxDate = MAX(dimDate[CALENDAR_DATE])
VAR QuarterStartDate =
    LOOKUPVALUE(
        dimDate[FISCAL_QUARTER_START_DATE],
        dimDate[QTD_WEEK_NAME],
        PriorPeriod
    )   
VAR PriorMaxDate =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX(dimDate[CALENDAR_DATE]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(dimDate),
            dimDate[QTD_WEEK_NAME] = PriorPeriod
        )
    )

SWITCH(
    true(),

    -- Quarterly
   PeriodType= "q",
    IF(
        HasPriorTitle,

            [Current AVG MAU],
            REMOVEFILTERS(dimDate),
            Franchise[TITLE_CODE] = CurrentTitle, dimDate[YEAR_QUARTER] = PriorPeriod,

            [Current AVG WAU],
            REMOVEFILTERS(Franchise), REMOVEFILTERS(dimDate),
            Franchise[TITLE_CODE] = PriorTitle, dimDate[FISCAL_PERIOD_NAME] = PriorPeriod,

            REMOVEFILTERS(dimDate),
            Franchise[TITLE_CODE] = CurrentTitle, dimDate[FISCAL_PERIOD_NAME] = PriorPeriod,

            REMOVEFILTERS(Franchise), REMOVEFILTERS(dimDate),
            Franchise[TITLE_CODE] = PriorTitle, dimDate[FISCAL_WEEK_NAME] = PriorPeriod,
            LEFT(LOWER(Lumina_Portfolio[CADENCE]), 1) = "w"
        ),
        CALCULATE(
            [Current AVG WAU],
            REMOVEFILTERS(dimDate),
            Franchise[TITLE_CODE] = CurrentTitle, dimDate[FISCAL_WEEK_NAME] = PriorPeriod,
            LEFT(LOWER(Lumina_Portfolio[CADENCE]), 1) = "w"

measures.name: Current KPI YoY Display
measures.expression:
VAR _kpi = SELECTEDVALUE ( KPI_Master[Order] )



VAR selectedperiod = LOWER([Selected Period Field Name])
VAR _periodType = IF ( selectedperiod = "qtd", "q", LEFT ( LOWER ( selectedperiod ), 1 ) )
VAR _cadence =
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        selectedperiod = "qtd", "quarterly",
        LEFT(selectedperiod,1) = "w", "weekly",
        LEFT(selectedperiod,1) = "q", "quarterly",
        "monthly"
    )
-- Force QTD to evaluate YoY using Quarter rules
VAR _OrderOverride = IF(selectedperiod = "qtd", 0, MAX('Time Period Parameter'[Time Period Parameter Order]))

VAR _pct = 
    CALCULATE ( 
        [Current KPI YoY %], 
        REMOVEFILTERS ( Lumina_Portfolio[CADENCE] ), 
        Lumina_Portfolio[CADENCE] = _cadence--,
        --TREATAS({_OrderOverride}, 'Time Period Parameter'[Time Period Parameter Order])
    )

VAR _delta = 
    CALCULATE ( 
        [Current KPI YOY delta], 
        REMOVEFILTERS ( Lumina_Portfolio[CADENCE] ), 
        Lumina_Portfolio[CADENCE] = _cadence --,
       -- TREATAS({_OrderOverride}, 'Time Period Parameter'[Time Period Parameter Order])
    )

VAR _sign_pct =
    IF ( _pct > 0, "+", "" )

VAR _pct_txt =
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( _pct ),
        FORMAT ( _pct, "+0%;-0%" ) 
    )

VAR _is_rate_kpi =
    _kpi IN { 30, 40, 50, 70 }

VAR _kpi_currency =
    _kpi IN { 80, 81, 112, 210, 211, 230, 240 }

VAR _sign_delta =
    IF ( _delta > 0, "+", "" )

VAR _delta_txt =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),

        -- Percentage point KPIs
        _is_rate_kpi,
            _sign_delta
                & FORMAT ( _delta * 100, "0.0" )
                & "pp",

        -- Currency KPIs
        _kpi IN { 80, 81, 112 },
            IF (
                ABS ( _delta ) < 100,
                _sign_delta
                    & "$"
                    & FORMAT ( _delta, "0.0" ),
                _sign_delta
                    & "$"
                    & FORMAT ( _delta / 1000000, "0.0" )
                    & "M"
            ),

        -- Revenue KPIs
        _kpi IN { 210, 211, 230, 240 },
            _sign_delta
                & FORMAT ( _delta / 1000000, "$0.0" )
                & "M",

        -- Default
        _sign_delta
            & FORMAT ( _delta / 1000000, "0.0" )
            & "M"
    )
VAR _result =
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( _pct )
            || ABS ( _pct ) > 10
            || ABS ( _pct ) < 0.0001,
        "N/A",
        _pct_txt & " (" & _delta_txt & ")"
    )

RETURN
    _result

        )
    )
